Traditional systems such as the Ten Gods of Saju, Zi Wei Dou Shu and the 27 lunar mansions inspire the setting, but their rules have been adapted for the story. The novel is not a divination guide. Editors review the prose before publication. Please contact us if you notice an error or inconsistency.
